description: New production units for self-consumption is a dataset listed in E-REDES open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution operator, published or maintained by E-REDES (Portugal). Number of new Small Production Units (UPAC) completed by municipality and connection power. Monthly data granularity. 1. The information made available by E-REDES constitutes an approximation to the values taken from the system and is based on the moment in which it is collected. Coverage: Portugal. The portal files it under Renewables. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eredes-open-data-portal.
